premises: Binary64 arithmetic with no fast-math; nontrapping execution and floating exception flags outside observable contract.
Successful bind with finite means and positive finite scales; valid pointers with immutable live backing arrays and serialized callers. bind retains pointers rather than deep-copying their data.
proof.argument: For each coordinate, nonfinite w is NaN or signed infinity. Multiplication by positive finite scale and addition of finite mean cannot yield a finite value. Thus finite(chart) implies finite(w). For finite w, both implementations evaluate the identical chart and reject overflow/nonfinite chart identically. The per-coordinate predicates and first rejecting coordinate are equal. Remaining support arithmetic, all output writes, configuration validation and all callers are unchanged. supported writes no state. Therefore return classification and admitted numerical/state behavior agree under the premises.
proof.scope: Exact admitted numerical/state refinement with rejection classification preserved; not universal floating-environment or NaN-payload equivalence.

findings.detail: Generated core comparison after normalizing generated include paths differs only by removal of !isfinite(w[j]) in supported. No configuration validation was removed.

Independently checked ELF SHA256 against each measurement and recomputed allocated address spans. Physical observable harness baseline/cached_exp 24768 B; chart_finite/combined 24712 B. 56 B static saving. cached_exp has no demonstrated additional saving.

Both separate fixture executables report status 0, allocation 6912 B and observed stack 664 B. M23 code executed on M33 QEMU. This is not a physical observable harness stack bound or target timing measurement.

Independently reran corrected check.py: 20400 paired classifications, 6190 accepted. Covers seeded normal/raw-bit inputs, every coordinate with NaN/infinities/extreme finite/subnormal/signed zero, invalid mean/scale binding and extreme positive scales.

Parent reports initial check001 used an interposable bind symbol and rejected all cases. It is invalid qualification evidence. Current test links -Wl,-Bsymbolic and asserts a positive acceptance count; independently reproduced corrected result.

README accurately limits proof to immutable live configuration and excludes fenv/NaN payload claims. It distinguishes separate stack witness from observable-input clean-image footprint and explicitly excludes initial invalid check001. Receipt embedded measurements and all recorded hashes independently verified.

result.scope: Return classification under nontrapping IEEE arithmetic; fenv flags not compared

limitations: No mainline promotion or complete firmware fit; 24712 B static exceeds 10240 B target.
No worst-case stack, timing, energy, lifetime rounding, aging or calibrated coverage qualification.
Mutable/corrupted configuration, concurrent mutations, invalid pointer accesses, floating traps and observed fenv flags are outside this proof.
No new long-stream controls; conditional local proof plus targeted classifications establish this isolated guard removal.
